description:
Retire the private git setup in the git-revision suite file in favour of the shared helper.

## Background

Shared test support provides a git initialisation function with a fixed author identity and no dependency on global git configuration. `crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/git_revision_tests.rs:15-20` hand-rolls `git init` with a fixed author identity in its `Repo` fixture.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `git_revision_tests.rs` initialises git only through the shared function.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each affected test asserts what it asserted before.
title: Git revision tests initialise git through the shared helper
